name: plugin-marketplace
description: A collection of useful Claude Code plugins for developers

plugins.name: code-review-plugin
plugins.description: Adds a skill for reviewing code quality, security, and performance

plugins.name: git-helper-plugin
plugins.description: Git workflow helpers: commit summaries and branch cleanup

plugins.name: test-runner-plugin
plugins.description: Skills for running tests and checking coverage

plugins.name: ddd-plugin
plugins.description: DDD domain layer implementation guide based on Evans / Vernon: brand types, companion objects, discriminated unions, Result-based error handling, Value Object / Entity / Aggregate / Domain Event / Domain Service patterns

plugins.name: ddd-visualizer-plugin
plugins.description: Visualize a TypeScript DDD codebase: AST analysis, interactive HTML viewer (layer + ER views), Mermaid markdown for PR attachments

plugins.name: react-ddd-superpowers
plugins.description: Full DDD development workflow for React + TypeScript + Vite: spec clarification, domain design with brand types and companion objects (classes only for Repository), DI/DIP composition root, strict TDD with Vitest, and adversarial review

plugins.name: angular-ddd-superpowers
plugins.description: Full DDD development workflow for Angular + TypeScript: spec clarification, domain design with brand types and companion objects (classes only for Repository and Angular components), DI/DIP via InjectionToken, strict TDD, and adversarial review
